core_obligations: Charts: choose a scheme $V$ surjective \'etale over $Y$ and a scheme $U$ surjective \'etale over $X \times_Y V$; then $U \to V$ is a surjective flat morphism of schemes (proof lines 1107-1113).
Reducedness of $X$ and $Y$ is defined in terms of reducedness of such charts (cited Properties of Spaces section), so the problem reduces to schemes (proof lines 1113-1116).
Conclude $Y$ is reduced by the scheme case (proof lines 1116-1118).
proof_roadmap: Use the definition of reducedness for algebraic spaces to reduce to schemes.
difficulty_reason: The proof runs the two-chart reduction: a surjective \'etale chart $V \to Y$ and a chart $U \to X \times_Y V$; flatness and surjectivity of $f$ make $U \to V$ a surjective flat morphism of schemes, reducedness of algebraic spaces is defined through such charts (cited section), and the scheme case concludes.
